name: Mucking Around halves Scarlet Delirium's cast time and doubles its cost (#2242)
contract: Mucking Around 681444 has both effects over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 256) = word 2 bit 8 = the six Scarlet Delirium records (801074, 803684-803688) and no other family-26 row. Effect 0 is aura 108 with MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100%; Scarlet Delirium is PowerType -2 (POWER_HEALTH) with ManaCostPercentage 20, and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST after its POWER_HEALTH branch, so the health cost really doubles. Effect 1 is aura 107 with MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) and BasePoints -1001 + DieSides 1 = -1000 ms; 803688 has CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, so it becomes 1000 ms. Tooltip: "Reduces the cast time of Scarlet Delirium by $/1000;S2 sec, but increases the health cost by $s1%." Regression guard for native behaviour.
